newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX FALLS 3.8 POINTS TO 852.4 PTS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB-120 INDEX FALLS 3.8 POINTS TO 852.4 PTS.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 3.8 points on Friday to 852.4, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Four of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the machinery index falling the most, down 43 points, or 3.65 percent, to 852.4 points.
Six indices rose, with the banking index rising the most, up 19 points, or 1.61 percent, to 1,199.5.
